briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate AGI timelines as compute bottlenecks intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier remains fiercely competitive with new model releases from multiple labs driving capability gains. Funding continues at record pace while safety concerns mount around deployment risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning, Anthropic followed with Claude 4 Opus, and xAI launched Grok-3 targeting real-time knowledge. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 while DeepSeek unveiled R2.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement actions target high-risk deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates as Microsoft and Google expand data centers. TSMC reports 3nm shortages amid sovereign AI chip investments from UAE and Saudi Arabia.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems with protocol-level security like DialectForge outpace centralized frontier labs by 2028?
